_note: Flags set on a morning once the date has passed (DateFlags, scripts/farm/date_flags.gd; Game's morning). `after` is a season and day: from the next day on, in that year and every later one, the flag is set whatever the farmer did. Nana's birthday scarf (fall 19, triggers_minamino.json) is the one case: a farmer who was never in Minamino that day still gets the scarf on the jizo from fall 20 on. Format: README.md, Events.
